items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: He was with Noble Sissle's band, and I used to go to see them quite often.

ctx.x: Yes, yes. So we played Indianapolis, and we pulled into Indianapolis this day and Noble Sissel was -- pulled in with his bus at the same time, and out of the bus stepped this woman which was the most beautiful woman I'd ever seen in my life. It was Lena Horne. She was just gorgeous. I -- she was quite -- I think she was in her late teens then. But just beautiful.
And I played with Nance's big band. This was just an aside.
